name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1934: He looked at a small charm in his MAGIC locker and asked from what picture is this here, and neither he nor the board could answer. A keeper row carried its quality, base, mods and checker verdict and NO frame, reel or session, while the card said stats read from your screenshot - a claim its own data could not support. The receipt was already in scope: thirty seven lines above the writer the same function builds a chronicle proposal carrying frameId, sessionId and firstSeenTs from meta, uses them for the chronicle and drops them for the vault. The tally lane for runes, gems and materials has keyed its durable ledger on session-frame-name since v889; keepers went through a different door and lost it. The writer now records all three and the card names the frame. Rows that predate this carry nothing and the card SAYS so rather than repeating the claim, telling him it cannot be traced and to untick it if he does not own it, because an item whose source cannot be produced is exactly the one he is right to distrust. The provenance branch first used an escaper that is not in that scope, and since only the with-frame case reaches that line it threw on exactly the case the feature adds while passing on the one that already existed - testing both branches is the only reason it was caught.
